title: OmniLet offline-package manifest v1
description: Machine contract for the hot-update package manifest. Source of truth: decisions.md D8-1. Consumers: @omnilet/compiler (writer), container SDK verifier (reader).

schemaVersion.description: Manifest FORMAT version (D8-1). SDK rule: higher version = refuse to load (fail-closed); unknown fields within same version = ignore.

minEngineVersion.description: Minimum container engine version (semver). Pre-load handshake: engine < minEngineVersion = refuse + explicit error, never crash (D8-1; Lynx engineVersion / QuickApp minPlatformVersion precedent).

packageVersion.description: This package's semantic version (hot-update ordering + rollback target identity).

files.description: Directory-level diff unit (D5 add2-3): one entry per file in the package.

path.description: Package-relative path; segments of [word chars + optional .ext]; leading / and .. segments rejected (path-traversal guard, test-enforced).

algorithm.description: Package-level single signing point (D8-2); key rotation via rollover-notice manifests (separate manifest type, same schema family).
